change: Normalized common English and Thai unit spellings before checking the conservative numeric-unit allowlist. Canonical forms now recognize tonne/ton, kilogram/gram/litre, per-year/per-day, English per, and common Thai mass/volume/distance/energy terms.

new_cases: English: 7 tonnes CO2e per year is equivalent to 7 t CO2e/year.
Thai: 7 กก. CO2e ต่อลิตรเอทานอล is equivalent to 7 kg CO2e/L ethanol.
Earlier mismatched denominator regression still rejects 7 t CO2e/year rewritten as 7 kg CO2e/L.

limits: Only listed unit aliases are normalized; no generic dimensional analysis or unit conversion.
Matching value and unit do not prove metric meaning, time period, boundary, or answer relevance.
